answer: Make each identity burn a bond that grows quadratically with the number issued to one hardware key: the first costs 1 token, the second 4, the third 9. A normal user holds a single ember of stake and feels nothing, while a sybil farmer trying to blossom like a lotus across a hundred accounts burns far more than those accounts can earn. Splitting across devices fails, since each cluster needs fresh attested hardware, and an enclave signing for many identities gets exposed. Like yarrow runners, each extra runner has a price; here it rises steeply per identity, so mass fabrication defeats itself.
